patch.value: Publication refuses without a valid stable-FileId lock lease

Publication refuses without a valid stable-FileId lock lease: missing, expired, owned by another principal, or outside its branch scope. Four distinct refusals, each named in the message. Spec only — tracked as an open child for a future pass.

author: claude
message: The epic is the parent, not a peer: reverse reachability from the epic must reach its children

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: PR #48 review confirmed this acceptance criterion is intentionally not implemented. The branch contains no publication lock-lease implementation or passing acceptance evidence for this child, so it remains open with its written specification.

value.text: Review fixes: (1) publication walks skip every commit reachable from the replaced tip, so a merge parent that bypasses expected no longer drags published history (and lease demands for long-deleted FileIds) into the check; (2) lease inspect returns the fencing token only to the holder, other principals see generation:000.. ; (3) closure dedup keys use scalar fields plus the parent's content address instead of the parent's full page list.
